rule.statement: A company cannot be represented by a power of attorney holder who resides within the jurisdiction of the court, unless the representation is by a registered attorney.
rule.supporting_quote: I think that Mr. Bawa's contention is correct, and that the proxy must either be signed by the party in person, or by a recognized agent as defined by sec. 25.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25(b) of the Civil Procedure Code
